watches.name: Sullivan Casecap
watches.description: Make your watch uniquely yours with a personalized Hampden Casecap®. Designed to replace the standard caseback of a compatible Hampden watch, the Casecap is a removable, interchangeable piece that gives you the opportunity to create something entirely personal. Available in both 37mm and 42mm sizes, each Casecap includes a custom design created by our team based on your ideas, story, interests, or inspiration. From meaningful symbols and monograms to artwork, dates, or personal messages, we’ll work with you to bring your vision to life. Please note: This listing is for the Casecap only and does not include a Hampden watch. Select the Casecap size that corresponds with your Hampden watch.

watches.name: First Hand Workshop 6498
watches.description: Join First Hand , Hampden’s best-selling watchmaking workshop in Chicago, hosted at our historic West Loop headquarters. Developed by third-generation CEO Joseph Wein, you’ll explore the mechanics of a Swiss mechanical movement, learning to disassemble, rebuild, and regulate it yourself. After a chef-catered lunch, you’ll add the dial and hands, case your watch, and take home our 42mm First Edition mechanical timepiece engraved with your initials.

specsRaw.Inside 14 days: if you can't attend or transfer your seat, your payment converts to HampdenWatch.com credit at 50% toward a future session or watch.

In all black steel, brushed steel, or two-tone with gold accents. Forty-two millimeters and 12mm through the case, on a Swiss Made Ronda quartz movement under a sapphire crystal, rated to 5 ATM. It ships with an integrated steel bracelet and an Italian leather strap lined with rubber, both quick-release, and the caseback is fully engravable.
